title: Verifiable live two-source execution and zkTLS provenance receipts
claim_boundary: Source-verified specification and granular execution playbook only; live two-source execution and cryptographic zkTLS transcript attestation remain open implementation and live-verification gates. Path presence is not behavioural proof; assertion-level traceability governs implementation claims.

assertions.statement: Stateful cursor pagination, HTTP 429 Retry-After backoff and token-bucket rate governance in the shared live provider runtime
open_gates: Define TlsTranscriptCommitment and redacted header byte-range contracts in crates/evidence-search-contracts/src/lib.rs and crates/searchright-contracts/src/lib.rs with unit validation tests.
Implement PaginationCheckpoint, deterministic HTTP 429 Retry-After backoff, and duplicate-emission prevention on resume in crates/evidence-search-core/src/lib.rs.

Implement 4 KiB chunk SHA-256 Merkle root computation, secret-preserving byte redaction, and atomic checkpoint persistence in crates/searchright-connectors/src/lib.rs and crates/searchright-store/src/lib.rs.

Wire explicit LiveExecutionAuthorization and two-source PubMed + Europe PMC execution through crates/searchright/src/engine.rs, crates/searchright-cli/src/main.rs, and crates/searchright-mcp/src/lib.rs.
Implement offline .srpack zkTLS transcript Merkle verification in crates/searchright-provenance/src/lib.rs and record authorised redacted live receipts.
assertions.permitted_claim: Scaffolding exists; behaviour is not claimed.
